_meta.philosophy: Help everyone do their job; never make decisions for them.

features.name: Draft self-review from your evidence
features.description: Pre-populates each section of your self-review from goal progress, recognitions received, 1:1 notes you wrote, and milestones you logged. Every sentence cites its source — you accept, edit, or reject.
features.trust_pattern: Every drafted sentence shows the source artifact. Hover to see the original. One-click 'reject' shows alternative phrasings.

features.name: Evidence drawer beside the form
features.description: Persistent right-rail showing all of your evidence for this cycle — recognitions, completed goals, 1:1 notes, peer feedback received. Drag any item into your draft and it becomes a citation.
features.trust_pattern: Nothing is auto-inserted. Drawer is read-only; you choose what to cite.

features.name: Translate your draft FR ↔ EN
features.description: Write in your strongest language; submit in the language your manager uses. Side-by-side panes show source + translation so you stay in control of the final text.
features.trust_pattern: Source language is what gets submitted; translation is a courtesy view for the manager.

features.name: Tone & confidence check before submit
features.description: Before you send, the system reads your draft and flags hedging language, missing impact statements, or sections shorter than your previous self-review. Coach, not editor.
features.trust_pattern: Suggestions only — your wording is sacred. You can dismiss all and submit.

features.name: Three-pillar evidence synthesis
features.description: For each direct report, the system pre-organizes the manager's view of evidence under the three pillars (Boost Individual / Catalyze Collective / Build the Team). Manager writes the narrative; system supplies the receipts.
features.trust_pattern: Synthesis is a draft. Every claim cites 14+ sources visible in one click.

features.name: Préparation groupée — write reviews side-by-side
features.description: Open 2–3 team members' reviews at once. Keep wording calibrated, spot inconsistencies in tone, finish the batch in one sitting.
features.trust_pattern: Pure layout — no cross-suggestion. Manager sees what they wrote.

features.name: Peer feedback summarized into 3 themes
features.description: Manager sees 5 peer responses summarized as 3 themes with raw quotes one click away. Peer attribution settings respected per question.
features.trust_pattern: Raw responses always 1 click away. Themes never replace reading.

features.name: Level criteria visible while writing
features.description: The Qontoer's current and next level definitions stay pinned beside the form. Calibrates 'is this an L5 narrative or an L6 narrative' before the manager submits.
features.trust_pattern: Reference material only. No suggestions, no judgments.

features.name: Recall every 1:1 since the last cycle
features.description: Manager can scroll their own 1:1 notes with this person back to the previous review, organized by topic. Stops review-writing from being 'what do I remember from January?'
features.trust_pattern: Manager's own notes. Nothing is summarized without an explicit click.

features.name: Respond to a peer request in 5 minutes
features.description: Compact form, one-anchor-question per page, save-and-resume, anonymity setting per question. Designed to feel like a chat reply, not a survey.
features.trust_pattern: Anonymity is per question, not blanket. Peer sees exactly what their manager will see.

features.name: Your praise & feedback history
features.description: Every Qontoer sees their own incoming praise + feedback in one timeline. Use it for your self-review; export it any time.
features.trust_pattern: User-owned timeline. Includes downloadable archive.

features.name: 3×3 calibration box view (Lattice-style)
features.description: Avatars on a configurable 2-axis grid. Drag to move; every move requires a one-line reason. Live updates for everyone in the meeting.
features.trust_pattern: Every move is auditable. Comments are tied to moves, not buried in a chat.

features.name: AI synthesis card on hover
features.description: Hover any avatar in calibration: a 3-bullet AI summary appears with sources. Speeds 'who is this person?' from minutes to seconds, without ever proposing a rating.
features.trust_pattern: Bullets cite their evidence. One click expands to the full review.

features.name: Live rating distribution as you move
features.description: Bell curve shows the current distribution and updates as managers move avatars. If a manager pulls the distribution out of shape, they see it instantly.
features.trust_pattern: Distribution is a data view, not a forced curve. No 'must conform' nudges.

features.name: Multi-cursor live calibration room
features.description: Several managers in the box view at once, like Figma. See whose hand is on whose move, with avatar cursors and live presence.
features.trust_pattern: Presence is visible — no one moves 'in the dark.' Every action is attributed.

features.name: Aggregate manager-bias signals
features.description: Surfaces 'Cards squad runs +1 tier vs Engineering overall' or 'three managers haven't cross-calibrated yet.' Patterns about populations, not verdicts about people.
features.trust_pattern: Frames as 'worth a conversation,' never 'biased manager.' Always linked to a sample-size disclaimer.

features.name: Configurable calibration axes
features.description: Admin (or facilitator) picks which two review questions become X and Y for the box view. Defaults match Qonto's three-pillar framing but every team can choose.
features.trust_pattern: Defaults are visible; deviations are visible. No hidden weighting.

features.name: Position-in-band on every row
features.description: Each Qontoer's row shows a horizontal band (min / mid / max) with current salary marker + proposed-move arrow. The signature Figures pattern, anchored on the salary grid.
features.trust_pattern: Band is the source of truth. Manager always sees how their move maps to the band before typing a number.

features.name: Live envelope tracker
features.description: Budget total at top of the worksheet updates as the manager types. Color-coded against the cap. 'Committed' and 'pending review' split visible at a glance.
features.trust_pattern: Live math; no soft caps; manager can go over with a reason.

features.name: Recommendation matrix (rating × position-in-band)
features.description: System fills a recommended raise from the rating × band-position grid the People team configures. Manager sees the recommendation, the math, and overrides with a one-line reason.
features.trust_pattern: Recommendation is configured by People team and visible. Manager overrides freely with a reason.

features.name: Compa-ratio beside every salary
features.description: Small 0.94 / 1.05 marker on every salary cell. Standard vocabulary for comp pros; instant read for everyone.
features.trust_pattern: Pure data view.

features.name: Sandbox: preview a policy change before commit
features.description: Before locking the cycle, run the proposal against the live population in sandbox. See the equity heatmap, distribution and band drift before anything ships.
features.trust_pattern: Explicit 'this is a sandbox, no data changed' state. Diff vs current visible.

features.name: Pay-equity heatmap (level × dimension)
features.description: Live cells per level × (gender, tenure, office, function) showing % gap, with 'explained vs unexplained' split. EU Pay Transparency-ready.
features.trust_pattern: Thresholds visible. Cells link to the population behind them. Never names individuals.

features.name: Visual comp letter, three-pillar framed
features.description: Generated letter with new salary, level, equity grant, total rewards, position-in-band, manager note. Edits in-place; sends in-app + PDF.
features.trust_pattern: Structured numbers come from the system. The 'note from your manager' is hand-written every time.

features.name: AI checklist before send
features.description: Before the manager sends the letter, an inline checklist confirms: three-pillar references present, skill-matrix moves named, one concrete andon/impact moment cited, forward framing.
features.trust_pattern: Checklist only flags, never auto-rewrites. Manager can dismiss every flag.

features.name: Configurable approval chain
features.description: Manager → Manager+1 → HRBP → Comp committee. Each level can comment back, not just approve/reject. Audit-logged.
features.trust_pattern: Audit trail visible to all parties. Comments are first-class, not buried.

features.name: Browse the career framework in-product
features.description: Skill matrix as a navigable graph: levels (rows) × dimensions (columns), every cell expandable to its anchor behaviors. Browse your level, the next, the path to manager. PDFs go away.
features.trust_pattern: Framework is structured data — not a screenshot of a PDF. Searchable, linkable.

features.name: Gap-to-next-level by dimension
features.description: Side-by-side view of your current level vs the next level on each dimension, marked with your last assessment. Shows what 'becoming the next best version' looks like operationally.
features.trust_pattern: Gap is drawn from your last Progress Review notes. Editable; you can add your own annotations.

features.name: Promotion case authoring
features.description: Structured template: per-dimension evidence with citations from your recent work and peer feedback. Manager and Qontoer co-author; HRBP joins for comp committee.
features.trust_pattern: Drafted from your evidence; you write the narrative. Comp committee sees both the draft and the receipts.

features.name: IC ↔ manager mobility paths
features.description: Visible path between IC and manager tracks at each level. Shows 'what would shift in your dimensions if you moved' without committing to anything.
features.trust_pattern: Exploratory view; nothing committed. Stays private until you decide to share.

features.name: Your own band, mid, position
features.description: Every Qontoer sees their level's band (min / mid / max), where their current salary sits, and how that mapped to past moves. EU Pay Transparency Directive built in.
features.trust_pattern: Own band always visible. Historical moves visible. No surprise ranges.

features.name: EU PT right-to-information request
features.description: Qontoer triggers the legal right-to-information flow on average pay levels at their level (broken down by sex, per the directive). Tracked, audited, country-aware.
features.trust_pattern: Request is logged with timestamps. Response SLA visible. People team sees the queue.

features.name: 3-step campaign launch (population → form → planning)
features.description: Launch a Progress Review or comp window in three steps with a sandbox preview. Matches the vocabulary Qonto's RH team uses with Lucca.
features.trust_pattern: Preview a single fake employee before launch. No 'send and pray.'

features.name: Clone any setting from last cycle
features.description: Start any campaign by cloning the previous one. See exactly what was reused, what changed. Reduces cycle-2 setup from hours to minutes.
features.trust_pattern: Diff view between current and prior visible at every step.

features.name: Mid-cycle adjustments without restart
features.description: Add a Qontoer who joined after launch, extend a deadline, fix a typo in a question — without resetting progress already saved.
features.trust_pattern: Every change is logged and the affected population sees a banner.

features.name: Cross-office progress dashboard
features.description: One screen for cycle progress across 8 countries: self-review %, peer responses, manager drafts, calibrated. Click any cell to nudge or open.
features.trust_pattern: Nudges go to managers, not employees-direct. Nudge cadence is visible to everyone.

features.name: Manager rater-pattern view
features.description: Per-manager distribution of ratings vs the function average. Surfaces who runs high/low. Frames as 'patterns,' never as bias accusations.
features.trust_pattern: Population view, not individual. Includes confidence intervals when samples are small.

features.name: Three-pillar outcome roll-up
features.description: Cycle-end summary: how the outcomes map to Boost Individual / Catalyze Collective / Build the Team. Connects review outcomes back to The Qonto Way.
features.trust_pattern: Always cites the underlying numbers. Narrative is a wrapper, not a replacement.

features.name: EU Pay Transparency report export
features.description: Generates the report the directive requires for employers in scope (gender pay gap by category, joint pay assessment trigger). One click, signed by HRBP, archived.
features.trust_pattern: Methodology is documented in-product. Numbers tie to the live population at the moment of export.

features.name: Index Égalité Femmes-Hommes (FR)
features.description: French Penicaud Index calculation per the 5 sub-indicators, with the official scoring rules baked in. Auto-updates as comp moves land.
features.trust_pattern: Official methodology cited. Score visible to leadership; not to managers in-cycle.

features.name: Betriebsrat consultation log (DE)
features.description: Works-council interactions for performance/comp changes are logged with the decision, the date, and the consultation document. Required by Mitbestimmung.
features.trust_pattern: Read-only audit chain. No edits after sign-off.

features.name: AI Act transparency surface
features.description: Per the EU AI Act's high-risk classification for employee evaluation tools: shows what AI did, with what data, when. Employees can see every AI artifact that touched their file.
features.trust_pattern: Every AI output is logged with model, prompt category, sources used, timestamp. Subject-access ready.

features.name: Per-record audit log
features.description: Every change to a Progress Review or comp record is logged: who, when, what changed, why (one-line reason required for sensitive fields). Immutable.
features.trust_pattern: Audit log is queryable. Subject-of-record can request their own.

features.name: Role-based visibility (per-field)
features.description: Demographics visible to HRBPs, not to line managers. Comp visible to manager+1, not peers. Country-specific overrides. Per-field controls, not per-page.
features.trust_pattern: Every viewer can see what's hidden from them as 'redacted,' not as a missing section.

features.name: 1:1 action items carry over
features.description: Open action items from the previous 1:1 auto-populate the next agenda. Bridge between continuous coaching and the formal review cycle.
features.trust_pattern: Action items belong to the pair. No AI editing — just carryover.

features.name: Andon signals log
features.description: When a Qontoer pulls the andon (in the lean / Qonto sense), it's logged with context. Surfaces during review as evidence of Ownership and Mastery values.
features.trust_pattern: Pulled by the Qontoer. Visible to their manager. Not 'surveillance' — affirmative signal.

features.name: Evidence collection from approved sources
features.description: Background job continuously gathers signals from HRIS, calendar, goals tool, peer praise into the Qontoer's evidence layer. Every source is named; every collected item is editable.
features.trust_pattern: Per-source opt-in. Qontoer sees the collection log. Can delete any item from their evidence.

features.name: Speak your self-review
features.description: Dictate your reflection in your own language; system transcribes and lightly cleans up — keeps your voice, never rewrites.
features.trust_pattern: Raw vs cleaned shown side by side; user picks which goes in.

features.name: SMART-goal language coach
features.description: Suggests sharper phrasing on a goal as you write (SMART or COIN). Side-by-side; inline; never auto-replaces.
features.trust_pattern: Original + suggestion shown; framework named ('SMART check').

features.name: "Add evidence?" prompt
features.description: When you write an unsupported claim ('I improved team velocity'), the system prompts: 'want to attach the PR, metric, or quote?' Never invents evidence.
features.trust_pattern: Prompt is a question, not a rewrite. Dismissable.

features.name: "Where does this map?" reflector
features.description: You describe an achievement; system shows which competency dimensions it touches in the framework — for self-positioning, not auto-rating.
features.trust_pattern: Shows exact framework text + 'possibly maps to' confidence.

features.name: Recognition echo panel
features.description: Sidebar surfacing structured recognition you received this cycle, ready to cite into your self-review with one click.
features.trust_pattern: Only structured kudos. Visible only to the recipient until cited.

features.name: Evidence auto-tagging
features.description: When you log an accomplishment, AI proposes goal + competency tags. You confirm or reject; never silent writes.
features.trust_pattern: Top-3 candidates + 'none of these'. Reject is first-class.

features.name: Self-evidence search
features.description: Inside the self-review draft, search 'show me everything I logged about onboarding.' Returns your own HRIS entries as citable snippets.
features.trust_pattern: Strictly your own data. Search history not shared with manager.

features.name: Career-conversation recall
features.description: Ask 'what did my manager say about my presentation skills last year?' — semantic search across your own past 1:1s, reviews, check-ins.
features.trust_pattern: Only items the user can already read. Searches private.

features.name: Private growth streak
features.description: Private counter of self-development behaviors (check-ins logged, feedback requested, learning hours). Visible only to you.
features.trust_pattern: Private by architecture. No share button, no manager view.

features.name: Self-review tone preview
features.description: Live linting of hedging language, passive voice, weak verbs, and 'I' vs 'we' balance on your draft. Ephemeral; never stored.
features.trust_pattern: Same model as a spellchecker. Never visible to manager.

features.name: Cycle micro-checklist
features.description: Visual time-boxed checklist: gather goals → list wins → request peer feedback → draft → tone-preview → submit. Draggable, slot-aware, never auto-books.
features.trust_pattern: Visual scheduler only. Nothing lands on the real calendar without explicit click.

features.name: Review-writing time blocks (proposed)
features.description: During cycle window, propose 60–90 min calendar holds for review writing. Employee and manager get their own proposals; explicit accept required.
features.trust_pattern: Proposed only. Easy to decline; no nag.

features.name: "Shipped this half" draft
features.description: At cycle close, auto-draft an accomplishments section from your HRIS-only structured data (closed goals, OKR check-ins, recognition, projects).
features.trust_pattern: Always presented as 'draft — edit before submit'. Source rows visible inline.

features.name: 1:1 prep card
features.description: Before each 1:1, a read-only digest of the report's recent goals, progress they self-logged, recognition received, your last 3 notes, next career milestone.
features.trust_pattern: Pure retrieval. Nothing new generated. Manager adds notes during the meeting.

features.name: Unresolved-thread digest
features.description: Pre-1:1 panel of items you opened but never closed: goals with no progress in 14 days, action items you wrote without a checkbox, feedback you gave last cycle with no revisit.
features.trust_pattern: Only operates on the manager's own notes. No cross-manager comparison.

features.name: 1:1 typed notepad with action routing
features.description: Typed (never recorded) 1:1 notes. Mark a line 'action: report' or 'action: me' and it auto-routes to the right place.
features.trust_pattern: Never records audio. Report sees only the 'share' lines.

features.name: Conversation-starter library
features.description: Tagged playbook of opening frames for hard 1:1 topics: underperformer who is unaware, high-performer who is bored, promotion deferred, first feedback after a miss.
features.trust_pattern: Static content authored by HR. LLM only rewrites the template, never the personal data.

features.name: Hard-conversation sandbox
features.description: Ephemeral role-play partner. Type the situation (no employee name) and rehearse a hard 1:1 with a Socratic AI. No storage, no logs.
features.trust_pattern: No employee identifiers accepted. Transcripts ephemeral. Aggregate topic stats only.

features.name: Feedback tone check (manager)
features.description: Pre-submit linter on manager-written feedback: flags gendered/biased phrasing, vagueness, missing forward-action.
features.trust_pattern: Suggestions only. Manager sees lint privately; HR never sees flagged items.

features.name: Review structure scaffolder
features.description: Not a draft. A checklist: 'Strengths section is empty', 'You mentioned 3 examples, all Q4 — gap in H1?'. Helps you not miss sections.
features.trust_pattern: Gaps are questions, not autofills.

features.name: Grounded rationale draft
features.description: For a proposed rating, system drafts a rationale paragraph citing only the evidence the manager has already attached. Refuses to invent.
features.trust_pattern: Will not generate unsupported claims. If evidence is missing, returns a checklist.

features.name: Calibration-voice reference panel
features.description: Side panel showing typical phrasing per rating band — so managers self-calibrate during drafting without forced wording.
features.trust_pattern: Never auto-changes wording. Reference only. Corpus owned by calibration committee, refreshed each cycle.

features.name: Post-submit coaching prompts
features.description: After submitting a review, the system asks the manager Socratic questions: 'What's one specific behavior change you want to see by next cycle? What support will you provide?'
features.trust_pattern: Questions only. Output is the manager's plan, not AI's.

features.name: Calibration evidence pack
features.description: Per-report evidence pack for calibration: quotes from feedback, goal completion, scope of work. Calibrators discuss; AI does not propose levels.
inspiration: Lattice Performance Insights minus the recommender
features.trust_pattern: Evidence only; explicit 'no recommendation' disclaimer.

features.name: Situational 1:1 question suggester
features.description: Given current context (just shipped X, OKR Y in red, recent peer feedback Z), suggest 3 1:1 questions. Manager picks 0 or more.
features.trust_pattern: Openers, not scripts. Named 'suggestions'.

features.name: Specificity coach for peers
features.description: When a peer writes 'great team player,' the system prompts: 'Can you point to a specific moment?' Escapable — never blocks submission.
features.trust_pattern: Prompt is escapable ('submit anyway').

features.name: Peer feedback language bridge
features.description: Peer writes feedback in their native language; subject reads it in theirs. Both versions saved; original marked canonical.
features.trust_pattern: Both versions visible to the subject.

features.name: Optional tone softener
features.description: For critical feedback, an opt-in 'want a more constructive phrasing?' suggestion — without watering down content.
features.trust_pattern: Opt-in only. Original and softened shown side by side.

features.name: "Help me write feedback for X" assembler
features.description: When you click 'give feedback to X,' the system surfaces shared work artifacts you both touched — so you write from collaboration, not blank page.
features.trust_pattern: Collabs are links, not summaries. Peer writes the prose.

features.name: Recognition specificity coach
features.description: When someone writes 'great job!', the system asks 'great job at what specifically?' before sending. Doesn't replace; sharpens.
features.trust_pattern: Send-anyway escape hatch. Framed as suggestion, not block.

features.name: "Have you considered recognizing X?" nudge
features.description: Surfaces low-recognition moments (a colleague shipped something nobody acknowledged) as a *suggestion*, not auto-recognition.
features.trust_pattern: Nudge is one-click dismissable. Never sends without explicit write.

features.name: Survey theme clusterer
features.description: HR loads engagement-survey free-text responses; system clusters into themes with example quotes. Themes labeled by AI but HR can rename/merge/split.
features.trust_pattern: Each theme expands to show every supporting quote. HR can dispute or rename.

features.name: "What employees keep asking" log
features.description: Dashboard of questions the policy-Q&A bot couldn't answer — gap-finder for the employee handbook.
features.trust_pattern: Aggregated counts, anonymized. HR decides what to write.

features.name: Personalized completion nudge
features.description: Instead of broadcast emails, the system generates contextual nudges: 'You have 3 reviews due — here's the suggested order, longest collaboration first.'
features.trust_pattern: Suggestion can be ignored. Never marks complete on behalf.

features.name: Cycle process-health monitor
features.description: Surfaces patterns: which managers submit reviews 2× faster than average, which 360 raters always say 'exceeds,' calibration meetings that ended in <30 min. Pattern surface, not action.
features.trust_pattern: Patterns are conversation starters, not auto-tickets.

features.name: Compensation rationale explainer
features.description: After humans decide comp, the system writes a personalized explanation pulling from the actual factors (band, position-in-range, performance signals). Does NOT propose the number.
features.trust_pattern: Explanation cites policy components. Manager reviews before send. Employee follow-ups route to the manager.

features.name: Cycle initiative dashboard
features.description: Opt-in org-level behavioral nudge during a cycle ('every manager spends ≥30 min in dedicated review writing per report'). Measured at team level, never individual.
features.trust_pattern: Team-level only. Easy team opt-out. Initiative ends with cycle.

features.name: Browse the framework in-product
features.description: Skill matrix as a navigable graph: levels × dimensions × paths. Click a level, see all competencies × expectations. PDFs go away.
features.trust_pattern: Framework is structured data — searchable, linkable, versioned.

features.name: Per-employee radar profile
features.description: Radar chart of your assessed level per competency (not one global level). Snowflake-shape is native, not derived.
features.trust_pattern: Each dimension cites the evidence behind the assessment.

features.name: Team competency heatmap
features.description: Team-level heatmap of strengths and gaps across competencies. Helps managers spot 'we're thin on system design at L4.'
features.trust_pattern: Team-level only. Never compares individuals against each other.

features.name: Framework versioning + diff
features.description: Diff a framework version against the previous one. Tell employees exactly what changed and why.
features.trust_pattern: Changelog is public. Old versions remain queryable for ongoing review cycles.

features.name: Anchor-behavior search
features.description: Search 'who has demonstrated anchor behavior X?' across submitted evidence. Helpful for talent reviews and succession.
inspiration: Anchor behaviors as arrays on LevelExpectation
features.trust_pattern: Returns evidence, not labels. HR draws the conclusion.

features.name: IC ↔ Manager track-switch wizard
features.description: Show level equivalence when moving IC→Manager or Backend→Platform — Square's L6=L6 pattern.
features.trust_pattern: Exploratory; nothing committed until the employee initiates a mobility conversation.

features.name: My salary band reveal
features.description: Buffer-style transparency: see the band for your current level + location, and the band for the next level if you promote. Mid-band + percentile visible.
features.trust_pattern: Band is the source of truth. No surprise ranges.

features.name: Per-decision rationale capture
features.description: Every comp decision (offer, raise, promotion, bonus, equity) requires structured rationale tied to gender-neutral criteria (skills, effort, responsibility, working conditions). Frozen at decision time — legal evidence for burden-of-proof reversal.
features.trust_pattern: Immutable once decision lands. Reason field is required for high-stakes changes.

features.name: EU PT right-to-information request
features.description: Employee self-service flow: request own pay info + comparator-group medians by sex. 2-month SLA, audit log, annual auto-reminder.
features.trust_pattern: Request logged with timestamps. Response SLA visible. HR sees the queue.

features.name: EUPT gender pay-gap report
features.description: Median + mean pay gap, total + by variable/equity component, broken down by category of workers doing equal/equivalent work. Annual for ≥250.
features.trust_pattern: Methodology documented in-product. Numbers tie to live population at export time.

features.name: Joint pay assessment workflow
features.description: When unexplained gap ≥5% in any category isn't remedied in 6 months, trigger a joint assessment with worker reps (CSE / Betriebsrat / RSU / OR / Plan de Igualdad).
features.trust_pattern: Worker-rep export pack auto-generated. Status tracking across the 6-month remediation window.

features.name: Band-in-job-posting integration
features.description: Push salary range into ATS/job postings; block postings without a band; ban salary-history field in candidate forms.
features.trust_pattern: ATS integration is the enforcement point. Block is hard, not soft.

features.name: Annual right-to-info reminder
features.description: Auto-notifies each employee yearly of their EU PT right to request pay information. Required by directive.
features.trust_pattern: Once-per-year, opt-out audited.

features.name: Index Égalité Femmes-Hommes (FR)
features.description: Auto-computed 100-point Penicaud score on 5 indicators; publication-ready by 1 March each year.
features.trust_pattern: Official methodology cited. Score visible to leadership; not to managers in-cycle.

features.name: NAO / CSE evidence pack (FR)
features.description: Generate comp aggregates by category × gender for the Négociation Annuelle Obligatoire and CSE consultation; track negotiation conclusions.
features.trust_pattern: Export pack signed by HRBP. Conclusions logged in BDESE.

features.name: Entretien professionnel scheduler (FR)
features.description: Track the every-2-year (or post-2025 every-4-year) career-development interview obligation per employee under L6315-1. Flag overdue.
features.trust_pattern: Distinct from Progress Review. Required by FR labor law regardless of perf cycle.

features.name: Betriebsvereinbarung config layer (DE)
features.description: Every monitoring/evaluation parameter (data collected, who sees it, retention, AI use) configurable per-deployment, exportable as draft works agreement.
features.trust_pattern: Required by DE law (broad interpretation — even Excel triggers §87). Audit trail per config change.

features.name: Entgelttransparenzgesetz comparator response (DE)
features.description: Automated comparator-group median computation for individual pay-info requests (≥6 comparators, opposite-sex, equivalent role).
features.trust_pattern: Request and response both logged. Employee receives signed response.

features.name: Rapporto biennale generator (IT)
features.description: Ministry-of-Labour portal-format export of biennial gender report. UNI/PdR 125 certification-ready data.
features.trust_pattern: Schema matches MITE portal. Submission-ready.

features.name: CCNL livello attribute (IT)
features.description: First-class CCNL classification level on every employee + every comp decision. Decompose total comp into CCNL-mandated vs employer-discretionary.
features.trust_pattern: CCNL bands are the floor. Discretionary comp is the variable.

features.name: Registro retributivo export (ES)
features.description: Pay register in RD 902/2020 schema: average + median by sex × category × level, including all supplements.
features.trust_pattern: Annual update. Auditable computation chain.

features.name: Auditoría retributiva workflow (ES)
features.description: Pay-audit workflow producing the Plan de Igualdad diagnostic. Justification capture for any gap above threshold.
features.trust_pattern: Diagnostic frozen at audit time. Worker-rep export ready.

features.name: Belgian biennial comparative analysis (BE)
features.description: Long-form pay-structure analysis (function × seniority × qualifications × gender) per Loi 22 April 2012.
features.trust_pattern: Federal-format export.

features.name: Works-council methodology approval (NL)
features.description: Per the Dutch EU PT draft, the works council approves the *methodology* (not the data). Configurable methodology object with approval workflow.
features.trust_pattern: Methodology versioned. Approval is per-version.

features.name: ACT gender pay-gap report (PT)
features.description: Law 60/2018 format report + remediation-plan tracker with ACT (Autoridade para as Condições do Trabalho) submission status.
features.trust_pattern: Submission audit chain. Remediation plan tracked in-product.

features.name: Einkommensbericht export (AT)
features.description: Biennial income report by collective-agreement category × gender (mean + median). Secure Betriebsrat-only delivery channel.
features.trust_pattern: Confidential — only Betriebsrat + employees may see.

features.name: AI Act FRIA template & log
features.description: Auto-populate Fundamental Rights Impact Assessment from system configuration. Refresh on scope change. Deadline 2 Aug 2026.
features.trust_pattern: Pre-filled from system metadata. DPO + HRBP sign-off.

features.name: AI Act human-in-loop enforcement
features.description: Block any 'significant-effect' decision (promo, termination, comp >X%) from being finalized without recorded meaningful human review with override capability.
features.trust_pattern: Human review checkpoint logged. Override is first-class.

features.name: AI Act right-to-explanation
features.description: Per-decision explanation generator for any AI-influenced output. Employee-facing contestation flow.
features.trust_pattern: Explanation cites the AI artifacts that touched the decision. Contestation routes to HRBP + DPO.

features.name: Worker-rep AI deployment notification
features.description: Pre-deployment notification workflow to CSE / Betriebsrat / RSU / OR / Plan de Igualdad commission before any high-risk AI feature is enabled.
features.trust_pattern: Notification record is immutable. Activation gated on receipt confirmation.

features.name: DSAR export for perf records
features.description: Machine-readable export of all perf data per employee — records, manager notes, peer verbatims, AI outputs and their explanations. 1-month SLA.
features.trust_pattern: Subject-owned export. DPO oversight. Includes AI artifacts that touched the file.

features.name: Country-aware retention engine
features.description: Per-record retention with country defaults (FR 2y post-departure CNIL guidance; DE 6-10y payroll; etc.). Auto-purge with litigation hold flag.
features.trust_pattern: Retention policy versioned per country. Hold-on-litigation overrides default.

features.name: Appraisal template per role
features.description: Reusable template (KRAs + criteria + weights) attached to a role/designation. Same template applies across multiple cycles.
features.trust_pattern: Templates versioned. Changes don't retroactively alter past cycles.

features.name: KRA dimension (atomic)
features.description: Atomic Key Responsibility Area definition (title + description). Reused across templates and goals.
features.trust_pattern: Single source of truth for KRA names. Versioned.

features.name: Rating criterion (atomic)
features.description: Atomic feedback criterion ('Communication', 'Ownership'). Reused across templates, self-ratings and feedback records.
features.trust_pattern: One table, three contexts — the polymorphic-rating-row pattern.

features.name: Polymorphic rating row
features.description: One row shape (criteria + weight + rating value) reused as template (no value), self-ratings, and peer/manager ratings. Frappe's one-table-three-uses pattern.
features.trust_pattern: Schema enforces consistency. Calibration committee owns the criteria + weights.

features.name: KRA auto-score from goal progress
features.description: KRA score on the appraisal is auto-computed from the progress of goals tagged with that KRA (weighted average).
features.trust_pattern: Deterministic; no judgment. Bridge between 'employee owns goals' and 'manager rates KRAs.'

features.name: Goal-rating mode toggle
features.description: Per-cycle switch between auto-score-from-goal-progress and manager-rates-each-goal-manually.
features.trust_pattern: Cycle-level decision. Documented in cycle metadata.

features.name: 180° / 360° mode
features.description: Configurable: 180° = self + manager + reports; 360° = + peers. Cycle-level setting.
features.trust_pattern: Mode visible to participants. Settings frozen at cycle launch.

features.name: Reviewer relationship tagging
features.description: Tag each feedback record as self / manager / direct_report / peer / skip-level. Drives visibility and weighting.
features.trust_pattern: Relationship derived from org chart at request time; frozen on submission.

features.name: Merit-increase matrix (2D grid)
features.description: Editable grid (perf-quartile × compa-ratio-quartile) → merit %. People team edits once; system applies per Qontoer.
features.trust_pattern: Matrix is visible to managers. Overrides are visible to HRBP.

features.name: Merit eligibility gates
features.description: Boolean gate set (12+ mo tenure, perf ≥ 3, not on PIP, no recent promo) — Qontoers must pass all gates to enter the merit pool.
features.trust_pattern: Gates configured by People team. Exceptions require HRBP sign-off.

features.name: Budget-aware raise allocation
features.description: Given a raise budget + per-employee fair-target deltas, allocate raises minimizing % pay-deficit vs market. Optimization, not a matrix.
features.trust_pattern: Optimization objective visible. Manager can override and the system tracks deviation from optimum.

features.name: Final score aggregation
features.description: Read-only aggregate of goal + self + feedback weighted per cycle config. The Frappe `final_score_formula` pattern.
features.trust_pattern: Formula visible to everyone. Manager sees the components, not just the aggregate.

features.name: Compa-ratio bucket labels
features.description: Color-coded buckets: Critical Under (<0.85) / Below (0.85–0.95) / Aligned (0.95–1.05) / Above (1.05–1.15) / Over (>1.15).
features.trust_pattern: Buckets are aids; manager always sees the raw compa-ratio.

features.name: Yellow-state cell on change
features.description: After any rating change, the cell shows original (strikethrough) + new value side-by-side. Recency visible at a glance.
features.trust_pattern: Original always visible until calibration locks. No silent overwrites.

features.name: Comment-on-move thread
features.description: Each rating change spawns a threaded dialogue bubble with the justification. @mentions and activity feed bound to the move.
features.trust_pattern: Comments are tied to moves, not buried in chat. Audit-ready.

features.name: Multi-cycle history inline
features.description: 3 prior cycles shown in each row of the calibration table. Recency bias visible without context-switching.
features.trust_pattern: History is data, not narrative. Manager interprets.

features.name: Per-rater distribution panel
features.description: For each manager: their rating distribution vs the all-managers mean. Names the *manager pattern*, never any employee.
features.trust_pattern: Pattern-level surface. Confidence interval visible for small samples.

features.name: Calibration permission tiers
features.description: HR sees demographics; contributors see custom attributes only; participants never see calibration history.
features.trust_pattern: Permissions are visible to viewers. 'Redacted' rather than 'missing.'

features.name: Calibration activity feed
features.description: All changes auto-logged with user attribution. Export as audit log for the cycle.
features.trust_pattern: Immutable. Required evidence for burden-of-proof reversal.

features.name: Per-employee evidence drawer
features.description: Click a name in calibration → full review history, peer feedback, prior comments, AI summary with sources. Calibrators read; never relabel.
features.trust_pattern: Read-only. All sources cited.

features.name: Calibration column manager
features.description: Show/hide/reorder columns in the calibration table. Preferences persisted per user.
features.trust_pattern: Personal layout, no impact on others.

features.name: Async pre-meeting Ratings Preview
features.description: Calibrators react to manager ratings before the live session. Deltas surface as the meeting's agenda.
features.trust_pattern: Async input visible to managers before the meeting. Saves meeting time, surfaces disagreement early.

features.name: Lock with comment-realignment prompt
features.description: When locking, prompt managers to update their written feedback to match the calibrated rating before sharing with employees.
features.trust_pattern: Forces consistency between written feedback and final rating. Manager owns the edit.

features.name: Facilitator intervention prompts
features.description: When a flagged move surfaces, the facilitator gets scripted prompts ('Walk us through one example from Q1') — never auto-decides.
features.trust_pattern: Scripts authored by HR. LLM only adapts to the report's context, not the verdict.

rejected.name: AI-proposed performance rating
rejected.reason: Violates 'AI never produces a judgment-bearing output.' The manager owns the rating; AI helps them see the evidence.

rejected.name: AI-ranked top performers list
rejected.reason: Ranking individuals is a verdict, not a pattern. HR sees patterns, not rankings.

rejected.name: Attrition / flight-risk score per employee
rejected.reason: Per-individual risk scores invite acting on people instead of helping them. Aggregate retention insights are fine; per-person predictions are not.

rejected.name: Auto-calculated promotion-readiness score
rejected.reason: A 'score' is a judgment. The Qontoer + their manager own the promotion case; AI surfaces evidence, not verdicts.

rejected.name: Sentiment analysis of self-review language
rejected.reason: Reading personality off of text is unreliable, paternalistic, and incompatible with the right to make your own case in your own words.

rejected.name: Slack / email / code as evidence
rejected.reason: Out of scope per our standard-stack-only data sources decision. Avoids GDPR/works-council complications.

rejected.name: AI suggested comp number on initial load
rejected.reason: Pre-filled numbers anchor decisions before the manager has looked. Recommendation matrix is shown — manager must engage with it; nothing auto-fills.

rejected.name: AI-summarized 1:1 transcripts
rejected.reason: 1:1 is between two people. Recording + summarizing changes the trust dynamic. Manager logs their own notes; system never listens.

rejected.name: Real-time AI prompts during a 1:1
rejected.reason: Manager becomes a puppet. Report can feel something is 'off.' Erodes trust at the highest-frequency manager touchpoint.

rejected.name: Auto-detected 'winning behaviors' on individuals
rejected.reason: Treats people as patterns to optimize. Crosses into behavioral surveillance.

rejected.name: Personality scoring from public data
rejected.reason: DISC/MBTI on people without consent. CNIL / GDPR red flag in EU. Drift toward judgment.

rejected.name: Public leaderboard of writing scores
rejected.reason: Public ranking of employees on writing quality is degrading and chills honesty.

rejected.name: "Deal health" red/yellow/green per individual
rejected.reason: Treats colour as truth. Invites manager laziness — the dashboard makes the call.

rejected.name: Calendar hard-block auto-bookings
rejected.reason: Loss of autonomy. Prescription where description was needed. Calendar proposals must be opt-in.

rejected.name: Auto-recording every 1:1 by default
rejected.reason: Freezes candor. Recording must be explicit, opt-in, per session. Most EU works councils would refuse the default.

rejected.name: Agent autonomously acts on tickets
rejected.reason: Translated to perf: AI auto-writing review text and submitting. Removes the human signature; legally fraught (FR requires manager-signed appraisals).

rejected.name: Cross-employee retrieval ("show me everyone who…")
rejected.reason: Becomes ranking infrastructure. Permissioned RAG is fine; cross-employee retrieval is not.

rejected.name: Coaching transcripts shared with manager
rejected.reason: Confidentiality is the product. Breaking it kills the value.

rejected.name: Talk-time ratio metrics on 1:1s
rejected.reason: Quantifies the wrong thing as proxy for quality. Classic Goodhart.

rejected.name: Mandatory specificity that blocks submission
rejected.reason: Turns 'help' into 'obstruction.' Specificity coaches must always have an escape.

rejected.name: AI bias auto-redaction without showing the change
rejected.reason: Robs the reviewer of the learning moment. Suggest, don't silently write.

rejected.name: AI-summarized 1:1 transcripts kept by default
rejected.reason: 1:1 is between two people. Recording + summarizing changes the trust dynamic. Manager logs their own typed notes; system never listens.

rejected.name: "Signed by AI" review artifacts
rejected.reason: EU AI Act high-risk obligations require named human accountability. AI can draft; only a human signs.
